translations.web: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
translations.bsb: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
translations.kjv: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
translations.asv: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.
